Name: The Fenwatch Crossing
Description: Cross the drowned fens, choose a path through the reeds and face the brood of the Fen Mother. (Difficulty: easier)

Name: The Burning of Harrowmere
Description: Raiders torch the farmland around Harrowmere. Bring down the Hill Giant, hurry down the river road and survive the ambush at the gate. (Difficulty: harder)

Name: Escape from Cinderhold
Description: One of your heroes is held in the dungeons of Cinderhold, the Pyrelord's keep. Recover the three relics, free the prisoner and flee before the Ember Wraith catches you. (Difficulty: hardest)
